{{Top|leg}}
'''Rinzefruit''' was a possible cargo of legal [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] during the [[Rebellion era]].

[[Mirchidi NeMall]], captain of the [[NeHimmep (freighter)|''NeHimmep'']], once lost his cargo of rinzefruit when his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] collided with an uncharted [[asteroid squall]] c. [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].
